market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.9, down 17% over 60 days, 10-year yield 4.66%, dollar index 99.6. Broad risk-on rebound in chips, gold miners and copper names last week, but the headlines hold no family-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI fell 7.7% in 5 days but rose 1.2% on the last day; no OPEC+, supply or XOM headline. The only energy item is a Motley Fool dividend listicle, which is not a catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold rose 2.3% on the day and 7.1% in 5 days; NEM rose 7.2% on the day and 20.6% in 5 days. This is a large move already priced in, with no Fed, dollar or NEM headline. Chasing it is a momentum call, which has no edge.

chips.reasoning: The semiconductor ETF is up 7.8% in 5 days. The NVDA mentions are a robotics report and a Nasdaq streak article, neither a catalyst. TSMC monthly sales (about the 10th) are scheduled but one-sided in neither direction.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY, trial, pricing or regulator headline. The NeOnc readout and the Capricor suit concern other companies. LLY is 4% below its high with no cause visible.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX is up 11% in 5 days and copper fell 1.7% on the last day. The headlines hold only buybacks, tariff commentary and defense items, with no copper supply or demand news. Nothing named.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific headline (XOM or OPEC+ supply shock, NEM guidance, NVDA export-rule change or earnings read-through, LLY trial or pricing news, FCX/copper supply outage) with a one-sided setup.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the last note (08-05). Gold rose 7.1% and NEM 20.6% in 5 days, the semi ETF rose 7.8%, and WTI fell 7.7% in 5 days. LLY recovered (+3.2% in 5 days). Headlines on 08-10 were noise: no leader-specific catalyst in any family.

oil_gas.why: WTI whipsaw has no named cause; no XOM or OPEC+ headline.

gold_miners.why: The NEM +20.6% 5-day gold rebound is already priced in and no Fed, dollar or NEM headline explains it.

chips.why: The semi ETF is up 7.8% in 5 days with no NVDA-specific catalyst in the headlines.

pharma.why: No LLY, trial or pricing headline; LLY is 4% below its high.

copper_uranium.why: FCX strength (+11% in 5 days) has no supply or demand headline.
